children: RNS Number : 4220U  Blencowe Resources PLC  11 September 2026
, the graphite development company advancing the Orom-Cross Graphite Project in Uganda, is pleased to announce the launch of its new corporate website.
The new website provides shareholders and prospective investors with a clearer overview of Blencowe, Orom-Cross and the Company's strategy as it advances towards production.

It includes updated information on the Project, downstream beneficiation and Blencowe's strategy to develop a vertically integrated graphite operation, alongside dedicated sections covering the investment case, sustainability, corporate governance and investor information.
The Investor Centre provides access to the Company's latest regulatory announcements, presentations, financial reports and other shareholder materials.

Investors can also sign up to the Company's newsletter to receive the latest news and updates here:
The website will continue to be updated as Blencowe progresses Orom-Cross and reaches further key development milestones.
Neil McDonald / Peter Lynch / Hanna Leijonmarck
